integrity.proof_type: analytic recurrence and uniform quadrature-error estimate

scientific_limitations: The O(1) remainder is proved only for the specified low-energy dry-friction Poincare recurrence stopped at X<6 epsilon.
No result is claimed for the maximum switching count of all time-optimal trajectories.
The 2009 Reshmin full text was inaccessible; priority risk from unindexed quantitative recurrence analyses remains.
title: A bounded remainder for the pendulum dry-friction half-swing count
